Boundaries.Name: blocking-asking-transport
Boundaries.Contract: Borrow the blocking caller's retry history. Retain ASKING failure, drain both FIFO replies, and restore watchdog suppression before final caller inspection. Never arm a blocking command deadline.

Boundaries.Name: physical-connect-helper
Boundaries.Contract: Physical attempts borrow setup ownership. Recovered connection attempts are handled retries; pool generations do not create caller ownership.
